$comment: Permanent (301) redirects the worker serves. Each key must also be in wrangler.jsonc → run_worker_first, or the request never reaches the worker (check-parity rule 5 fails one without the other; smoke-worker asserts the 301). One-line reason per row, so a future editor knows whether the row is still earning its keep. Shape: "/old-path": { "to": "/new-path", "reason": "folded into the guide, 2026-10-01" }. Empty until a site needs one.
